description: The Georgian power system's electrical frequency in hertz, from the JSC Georgian State Electrosystem 1-minute real-time export — nominal 50 Hz, and how far it sits from nominal is a direct read on the balance between generation and demand. Carries the same ACT/SUB/NRE quality flag as the grid export.

max_lookback_slots.description: How many 1-minute slots to walk back looking for the most recent published reading. Default 15.
